necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the dual rhythm disturbance. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indications provided.
